$comment: Shape of the multitenant host's tenant index (D-098). The host keeps this file in its own repo; a copy lives here so the generic static-tenant recipe (between-gigs.md, section "Generic recipe") and HR-07 can point at one concrete form. Each entry registers a tenant by its repo and manifest path; everything else about the tenant comes from that manifest. `status`: registered (index entry only) | validated (tenant:validate green on `pinned`) | mounted (served at routePrefix) | retired. `pinned` is the commit the host last validated and mounted; null while unreachable.
